reading.body:
No building-specific megawatt figure has been published for this facility. The operator's specification page locates the campus at County Road 459 in Widows Creek Station, Jackson County, Alabama, and verification occurred on September 3, 2026, but does not disclose its power allocation or capacity.

This facility is recorded as a distinct legal entity entry for Google LLC but research notes indicate it is very likely the same underlying operation as Google's broader Alabama and Tennessee data center program, which is documented elsewhere in this registry under the main Google operator record. No individual megawatt figures were located in available sourcing.

Alabama has 12 mapped data center facilities, of which only 2 have published power specifications totaling 9.5 megawatts. This campus ranks third by published megawatt capacity in the state, though its own published capacity is zero. The state's total and ranking are therefore not derived from this facility's contribution.
